name: Hateful Words
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid hateful and corrupt speech, emphasizing that words can wound deeply like the piercing of a sword, while wise words bring health and edification. Ephesians instructs Christians to put away bitterness, wrath, anger, and evil speaking, replacing them with speech that ministers grace to listeners. The seriousness of guarding our words is underscored by Christ's call to remove anything that causes offense, highlighting the eternal consequences of unchecked sinfulness, including hateful words. Our past nature as children of wrath reminds us of the need for transformed communication that reflects our new life in Christ.
